QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: anchorRadius
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The vehicle must stay within this distance of the locked point before the anchor is considered settled. 0 disables the settle gate. Keep it above the position-hold accuracy of the vehicle: a radius below the noise floor never latches and the anchor stretches to its guard timeout.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: anchorSettle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Uninterrupted time the vehicle must stay inside the settle radius before the anchor duration starts counting. Leaving the radius resets this timer.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: anchorGuard
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Overall ceiling on a single anchor command, counted from when it starts. Guarantees the mission advances even if the vehicle can never settle. 0 uses the firmware default of duration*3 + 30 s.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: photoBefore
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: CONDITION_DELAY inserted after the camera turn and before the shutter fires, so the vehicle has settled on heading when the photo is taken.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: photoWindow
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hold time of the photo-window waypoint, and the anchor duration when Anchor is on. A camera turn adds 2 s on top. It must be longer than the DO/CONDITION queue, otherwise AP_Mission drops the queue and no photo is taken.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: diveSettle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hold on the dive-in-place waypoint. ArduSub declares a waypoint reached within WPNAV_RADIUS in 3D, so a short vertical leg completes while the vehicle is still shallow. This hold keeps the mission on the dive waypoint until it is actually at cruise depth.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: surfaceSettle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hold on the surface waypoint after ascending, before the camera turn and shutter sequence starts.
